scope: Posthoc read-only inspection. Target IDs come from prior incident reports and original snapshot facts; neither targets nor expected answers enter the classifier or retrieval adapter.
coverage_definition: A selected ID alone is not complete coverage. Match the entire persisted fact claim in a rendered memory with intersecting source provenance, or match every original supporting quote through intersecting source provenance.
Report per-quote completeness separately. A complete claim may be present even if an optional explanatory source quote is clipped.
A fact need not be independently selected: full original context on another selected fact with the same source can carry the missing evidence.
This is deterministic exact evidence coverage, not semantic answer correctness or a new score. Current state, reference identity and contradictory/decoy context still require review.
